info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Deposit Lending By Param1-spec
info.description: This API allows users to retrieve deposit lending information associated with a specific corporate current account by using the unique identifier param1. Ideal for businesses seeking detailed financial data regarding their deposit lending services, this endpoint is essential for financial institutions, accountants, and corporate treasurers. The primary resource accessed is related to corporate current accounts, helping users gain insights into lending opportunities and manage their financial portfolios effectively. Use cases include reporting, analysis, and strategic decision-making for corporate banking clients.

get.summary: Retrieve details of a corporate current account.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the comprehensive details of a specified corporate current account, including account balances, transaction history, and associated information.

requestBody.description: This request is used to retrieve information regarding the corporate current account identified by the account number ACC-200045. Please ensure that the request is structured according to the defined schema to ensure successful processing.
